reason: A Supreme Court ruling regarding the write-off of Rs. 8,400 crore in AT-1 bonds creates significant balance sheet uncertainty and potential capital impairment.
why_now: The market is reacting to the ruling as of October 15, 2026, with the company currently clarifying the impact.
source_headlines: Yes Bank Limited: The Exchange has sought clarification from Yes Bank Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Yes Bank share price sees sharp fall of 10% after Supreme Court ruling on Rs.8,400 crore AT-1 bond write-off. The response from the Company is awaited.
